description: A Svelte 5 data grid as a storefront: the same rows and columns as the table, shown as product cards with a photo, brand, star rating, sale price and a New, Sale or Sold out badge, drawn by a card snippet. One prop, gallery, switches the view; the category filter, search and sort are the grid's, and a click opens the product in a panel with Add to cart.

faq.question: Is the gallery a separate component?
faq.answer: No. It is the same <SvGrid> with the gallery prop set. The grid keeps its rows, columns, search and sort; the gallery draws the rows it would show as cards. Switch the prop off and the table is back, in the same order.

faq.question: Can I design the product card myself?
faq.answer: Yes. gallery.card is a snippet that receives each row, so this demo draws its own card: photo, brand, rating with review count, price with the old price struck through, and a badge. With onCardClick set, the whole card is one button, by click or by Enter.

faq.question: Where does the cover image come from?
faq.answer: From the field named in coverField: an image URL, or a list of files whose first image is used. coverFit chooses between cropping to fill (cover) and showing the whole image (contain).

faq.question: Which parts need @svgrid/enterprise?
faq.answer: The gallery renderer: call enableGalleryView() (installEnterprise does it too). The gallery prop and its types are part of the MIT @svgrid/grid package; without the renderer the grid shows a note in place of the cards.
